Vendored browser libraries for open_build_map.py (1.162.0).
They draw the zoomable build-map page. Nothing is installed; the page loads
these two JavaScript files. Licences: LICENSES.txt (both MIT).

Do not edit by hand. To update, download the pinned file from jsDelivr,
strip a trailing sourceMappingURL comment, update this file and the CDN
constants in open_build_map.py, and run the tests.
